hints: You need one value per level, and it is the last one in left-to-right order. What do you already know that produces levels in that order?
The level-by-level queue walk. Take the last value of each level instead of the whole level.
A depth-first walk works too, if you visit the right child *before* the left one: then the first node you ever reach at a given depth is the rightmost.
With that ordering, record a value only when the depth you have reached is deeper than anything recorded so far.
